title: Career Roadmap: Investment Advisor
summary: Career Domain: Business, Finance & Entrepreneurship · Qualification Pathway: B.Com – B.Com - Investment / Wealth Management · Target Career: Investment Advisor

about.label: About this roadmap
about.text: This roadmap was drafted with AI assistance from OneGrasp's related roadmaps and is awaiting expert review. Check fees, dates, eligibility and exam patterns on the official websites before you rely on them.

about.label: Important
about.text: SEBI sets the qualification and registration rules for Investment Advisers - check its current requirements before you apply.

blocks.text: An Investment Advisor helps people plan their money - goals, risk, mutual funds, shares, insurance and retirement - and recommends what suits them. In India, giving paid investment advice needs SEBI registration as an Investment Adviser (RIA).

items.text: Understand a client's goals, income and risk appetite
Build and review a financial plan and portfolio
Explain products honestly, including costs and risks
Keep records and follow SEBI's adviser rules
Learn accounting, economics and personal finance
Track your own budget and a model portfolio
Read about how mutual funds and shares work
Study mutual funds, equity, bonds, insurance and tax
Intern with an advisory or wealth firm
Prepare sample financial plans for real families (with permission)
NISM Series X-A and X-B (Investment Adviser)

blocks.label: Before you enrol
blocks.text: Check the current syllabus, fees and eligibility on the certifying body's official website.
